issue_request: FHIR-34043 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 OO change request reporting that DocumentReference/$generate had persist typed as Binary instead of boolean, that persist was unclear, and that url should better account for source documents such as Binary, Composition, or Bundle. The approved resolution was to make persist boolean and define url as the URL to the source document, which may be a general URL or a Binary, Composition, or Bundle.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation. Jira links the August 2022 implementation history, and local source history contains 82d7ae7918, merged by f2d7b07e50, which added the url documentation and changed persist from Binary to boolean in source/documentreference/operationdefinition-DocumentReference-generate.xml.
additional_context: The initiating Zulip thread confirms the persist/type confusion and the desire to make $generate implementable. OO minutes on 2022-06-14 record the 5-0-0 decision to update the datatype and description. Later FHIR-39624 corrected the same operation's output to return/Bundle and is already represented on the combined branch. Current R6 source removed DocumentReference-generate from the core DocumentReference operations list, and ballot-intro points DocumentReference.$generate to API Incubator.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The retained operation source already has the FHIR-34043 url documentation and persist boolean type, and the current core build wiring no longer lists DocumentReference.$generate as a core DocumentReference operation.
